title: Add max_items option to fields.List
description: Adds an optional max_items argument to fields.List so APIs can cap how many items a client may send. Lists longer than max_items are rejected with a clear error message. Generators are supported by materializing them first. Tests included.

bugs.description: The length check uses >= instead of >, so a list with exactly max_items items is rejected even though the docstring and error message say max_items is the maximum allowed. Fix: len(value) > self.max_items.
